message.content:
Waterproof trench coat with a dropped hem, A-line silhouette, length reaching mid-thigh, color #2d3e50 (Deep Slate Blue), fabric composed of dense waxed cotton and nylon ripstop.
Merino wool blend turtleneck sweater, fitted ribbed neck, cropped length hitting just above the waistline, color #f5f0e6 (Warm Beige), fabric featuring natural wool fibers for insulation against frost.
Dark wash straight-leg denim jeans, classic five-pocket construction, ankle-length cut to prevent bunching during walking, color #1c1a18 (Charcoal Black), fabric treated with water-resistant coating and reinforced stitching at stress points.
Chunky leather hiker-style boots, lace-up front, thick lug sole for traction on snow and salted roads, mid-height shaft protecting against slush, color #5c4d46 (Warm Taupe), fabric of full-grain vegetable-tanned leather.
Silver-tone minimalist geometric pendant necklace in 925 sterling silver and brushed gold-tone oversized hoop earrings to add visual interest over the dark layers.

This ensemble works because it prioritizes essential warmth against the -10°C frost while maintaining a professional yet approachable look for work in an urban setting. The waterproof trench coat provides a necessary shield against snow and wind, ensuring comfort during the 20-minute walk without sacrificing style. The combination of textured wool and durable denim creates visual depth that elevates simple basics into a refined "neat" outfit suitable for office environments. Each piece is chosen specifically to handle wet, icy conditions while respecting the requirement for no outer layer when unnecessary, though here it is strictly needed for survival in winter weather.
